extName.message: Tabinet: タブ整理とセッション
extName.description: The extension name in Chrome and the Chrome Web Store title: the brand "Tabinet" (never translated), a colon, then a short description of what it is. At most 75 characters.

appName.description: Do not translate. The brand name alone, shown in the page header and the browser tab title.

extDescription.message: ワンクリックですべてのタブを並べ替えてグループ化し、ウィンドウ全体をセッションとして保存・復元できます。オフライン、アカウント不要、データは端末内に保存。
extDescription.description: The store summary and the line under the name at chrome://extensions. At most 132 characters.

localeCode.description: Do not translate. The language code of this file itself (en, ko, es, ja), not a word: it picks the plural rules and number formats that match this file's text, also when Chrome falls back to it for a language the extension does not ship.

actionTitle.message: Tabinet: クリックでタブを並べ替え、右クリックでセッション
actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon. Teaches the two gestures.

cmdSaveSession.message: 現在のウィンドウをセッションとして保存

cmdOpenDashboard.description: Keyboard command that opens the app page.

cmdAssembleTabs.message: 集合！（すべてのウィンドウのタブをこのウィンドウに移動）
cmdAssembleTabs.description: Keyboard command and right-click menu item: the action name, then what it does in brackets.

cmdPauseYoutube.message: YouTube の動画をすべて一時停止
cmdPauseYoutube.description: Keyboard command (listed at chrome://extensions/shortcuts) and item in the toolbar icon's right-click menu: pauses the video in every YouTube tab of every window. Menu item, keep it short (under 40 characters).

assembleName.description: Short name of the action that moves every window's tabs into the current one. Shown on a button.

commonCancel.description: Button that closes a dialog without doing anything.

commonSentenceJoin.description: How two complete sentences stand side by side in one text. $1 and $2 are full sentences. Most languages put a space between them; languages written without spaces (Japanese) put nothing. Japanese joins with no space; written with placeholders because Chrome reads "$1$" in "$1$2" as an undefined named placeholder and refuses to load the extension.

commonFactJoin.description: How two short facts are separated on one line, such as "3 windows · 87 tabs". $1 and $2 are the facts (either may itself be a joined list). Keep the middle dot separator unless your language uses another.

commonLoading.description: Shown while something (a session's tabs, the saved sessions, the open windows) is being read.

commonClose.description: Button or label that closes a dialog or panel.

tabCount_other.description: A number of browser tabs. $1 is the formatted count.

windowCount_other.description: A number of browser windows. $1 is the formatted count.

settingsSubtitle.message: 変更はすぐに保存されます。
settingsSubtitle.description: Line under the Settings dialog title: there is no Save button, every change is stored at once.

settingsLanguage.description: Accessible name of the language dropdown in the Settings dialog's title row (next to the close button).

settingsLanguageAuto.description: First choice of the language dropdown in Settings: the extension follows the language Chrome is displayed in. The other choices are the languages' own names and are not translated.

settingsLanguageTitle.message: このページとアイコンの右クリックメニューの言語です。「自動」を選ぶと Chrome の言語に従います。
settingsLanguageTitle.description: Tooltip of the language dropdown in Settings. The extension's name and the keyboard shortcut descriptions at chrome://extensions always follow Chrome's language, so this does not mention them.

settingsSaved.description: Short toast shown after any setting was stored.

settingsSaveFailed.message: 設定を保存できませんでした: $1
settingsSaveFailed.description: Error line shown when Chrome refused to store a setting. $1 is Chrome's own error message (usually English) or the word for an unknown error.

settingsSaveFailedPlain.message: 設定を保存できませんでした。
settingsSaveFailedPlain.description: Error line shown when Chrome refused to store a setting and gave no reason this page can explain in the UI language.

settingsUnknownError.description: Fills the error message of settingsSaveFailed when Chrome gave no reason. One lower-case word.

settingsAdvanced.description: Label of a fold in the Settings dialog that hides the settings people rarely change. One short word.

settingsAdvancedToggle.message: その他の設定を表示または非表示
settingsAdvancedToggle.description: Tooltip of the Advanced fold in the Settings dialog.

settingsSortingTitle.description: Heading of the Settings section about sorting tabs.

settingsSortingDescription.message: ツールバーのアイコンをクリックしたときの動作です。
settingsSortingDescription.description: Explanation under the Sorting heading in Settings.

settingsYoutubeTitle.description: Heading of the Settings section about pausing YouTube videos. The site name; keep it as is unless your language writes it differently.

settingsYoutubeDescription.message: アイコンを右クリックして「$1」を選ぶか、ショートカットキーを押すと、すべてのウィンドウの YouTube タブで動画が一時停止します。再生位置はそのままで、再生が再開されることはありません。
settingsYoutubeDescription.description: Explanation under the YouTube heading in Settings. $1 is the right-click menu item (cmdPauseYoutube), quoted.

settingsYoutubeAccess.description: Label of the Settings row that allows or removes the extension's access to youtube.com, needed to pause videos.

settingsYoutubeAccessOffHint.message: まだ許可されていません。動画の一時停止に必要で、Chrome が先に確認します。Tabinet は YouTube で一時停止を押すだけで、ページの内容は読み取りません。
settingsYoutubeAccessOffHint.description: Grey hint under "Access to YouTube" while the access is not granted.

settingsYoutubeAccessOnHint.message: 許可済み。アイコンを右クリックして「$1」を選ぶか、ショートカットキーを押すと、すべての動画が一時停止します。Tabinet は YouTube で一時停止を押すだけで、ページの内容は読み取りません。
settingsYoutubeAccessOnHint.description: Grey hint under "Access to YouTube" once the access is granted. $1 is the right-click menu item (cmdPauseYoutube), quoted.

settingsYoutubeAccessAskedHint.message: 「$1」を使うには、先にこのアクセスを許可してください。許可したら、もう一度「$1」を選ぶかショートカットキーを押してください。Tabinet は YouTube で一時停止を押すだけで、ページの内容は読み取りません。
settingsYoutubeAccessAskedHint.description: Grey hint under "Access to YouTube" when the person arrived from the menu item or shortcut without the access yet: explains why Settings opened. $1 (twice) is the right-click menu item (cmdPauseYoutube), quoted.

settingsYoutubeAllowed.message: YouTube へのアクセスを許可しました。もう一度「$1」を選ぶと動画が一時停止します。
settingsYoutubeAllowed.description: Short notice after the person allowed access to youtube.com in Chrome's prompt: tells them to run the command again. $1 is the right-click menu item (cmdPauseYoutube), quoted.

settingsYoutubeAllow.description: Button in the YouTube section of Settings: asks Chrome for access to youtube.com (Chrome then shows its own prompt). Short.

settingsYoutubeRemove.description: Button in the YouTube section of Settings, shown once access is granted: gives the access to youtube.com back. Short.

settingsYoutubeDeclined.message: YouTube へのアクセスが許可されなかったため、まだ動画を一時停止できません。
settingsYoutubeDeclined.description: Short notice after the person declined Chrome's prompt for access to youtube.com.

settingsYoutubeAccessFailed.message: Chrome で YouTube へのアクセスを変更できませんでした。もう一度お試しください。
settingsYoutubeAccessFailed.description: Error line shown when Chrome refused to grant or remove the access to youtube.com.

settingsSortBy.description: Label of the dropdown that chooses how tabs are ordered.

settingsSortByTitle.message: ツールバーのアイコンをクリックしたときのタブの並び順
settingsSortByTitle.description: Tooltip of the Sort by dropdown in Settings.

settingsSortByUrl.description: Sort by dropdown option: order tabs by their web address. Short.

settingsSortByTitleOption.description: Sort by dropdown option: order tabs alphabetically by page title. Short.

settingsSortByCustom.description: Sort by dropdown option: group tabs by site with the options shown under it. Short.

settingsTabGroups.description: Label of the dropdown that decides which tabs count as the same site when sorting by Custom.

settingsTabGroupsHint.message: 同じサイトとみなす範囲です。
settingsTabGroupsHint.description: Grey hint under the Tab groups setting.

settingsGroupingSubdomain.description: Tab groups dropdown option: mail.example.com and www.example.com are different sites. Short.

settingsGroupingDomain.description: Tab groups dropdown option: every subdomain of example.com is one site. Short.

settingsGroupingDirection.description: Label of the dropdown that chooses which end of the tab strip decides the order of the site groups.

settingsGroupingDirectionHint.message: タブバーのどちらの端を基準にサイトの順番を決めるかを選びます。
settingsGroupingDirectionHint.description: Grey hint under the Grouping direction setting.

settingsPreserveOrder.message: グループ内の順序を保持

settingsPreserveOrderHint.message: サイトごとのタブを開いた順のままにします。
settingsPreserveOrderHint.description: Grey hint under the Preserve order within groups switch.

settingsDuplicateTabs.description: Label of the dropdown that chooses what happens to tabs with the same address.

settingsDuplicateTabsHint.message: 同じアドレスが複数開いているときの処理です。
settingsDuplicateTabsHint.description: Grey hint under the Duplicate tabs setting.

settingsDuplicateKeepOne.description: Duplicate tabs dropdown option: close the extra copies. Short.

settingsDuplicateKeepAll.description: Duplicate tabs dropdown option: leave them alone. Short.

settingsDuplicateGroup.description: Duplicate tabs dropdown option: put the copies in one tab group. Short.

settingsSortingAdvancedDescription.message: 固定タブ、休止中のタブ
settingsSortingAdvancedDescription.description: Small grey text beside the Advanced fold of the Sorting section, listing what is inside.

settingsSortPinned.message: 固定タブを並べ替える

settingsGroupSuspendedHint.message: オン: 休止中のタブを1つのまとまりとして先頭に移動します。
settingsGroupSuspendedHint.description: Grey hint under the Group suspended tabs together switch.

settingsSessionsDescription.description: Explanation under the Sessions heading in Settings.

settingsSessionsAdvancedDescription.message: 間隔、保持する件数、遅延復元
settingsSessionsAdvancedDescription.description: Small grey text beside the Advanced fold of the Sessions section, listing what is inside.

settingsAutoSnapshots.message: 自動スナップショット

settingsAutoSnapshotsTitle.message: 開いているタブを一定間隔で自動的に保存します
settingsAutoSnapshotsTitle.description: Tooltip of the Automatic snapshots switch.

settingsSnapshotInterval.message: スナップショットの間隔
settingsSnapshotInterval.description: Label of the dropdown that chooses how often a snapshot is taken.

settingsSnapshotIntervalHint.description: Grey hint under Snapshot interval: the range a typed-in custom interval may take. $1 is the smallest number of minutes, $2 the largest.

settingsIntervalEvery_other.description: Snapshot interval dropdown option. $1 is the formatted number of minutes.

settingsIntervalCustomLabel.message: スナップショットのカスタム間隔（分）

settingsKeepLastHint.description: Grey hint under the Keep last setting.

settingsSnapshotsUnit.description: Unit shown right after the number field of the Keep last setting. One short word.

settingsLazyRestore.description: Label of the dropdown that chooses whether restored tabs load only when visited.

settingsLazyRestoreHint.message: タブを開いても、表示するまで読み込みません。
settingsLazyRestoreHint.description: Grey hint under the Lazy restore setting.

settingsLazyAuto.message: 自動（タブが$1個を超える場合）
settingsLazyAuto.description: Lazy restore dropdown option: only when a session has more tabs than $1, the formatted threshold (LAZY_AUTO_THRESHOLD in src/constants.ts).

settingsBackupTitle.description: Heading of the Settings section about exporting and importing sessions.

settingsBackupDescription.description: Explanation under the Backup heading in Settings.

settingsExportEverything.message: すべてをエクスポート
settingsExportEverything.description: Label of the row with the button that exports every session to a file.

settingsExportEverythingHint.message: 保存したセッションとスナップショットを1つの JSON ファイルにします。

settingsImportButton.description: Button that opens the import dialog. Short.

settingsBackupAdvancedDescription.description: Small grey text beside the Advanced fold of the Backup section, listing what is inside.

settingsShortcutsTitle.description: Heading of the Settings section listing the extension's keyboard commands.

settingsSortCommand.message: このウィンドウのタブを並べ替える（アイコンのクリックと同じ）

settingsShortcutSuggestedHint.message: 推奨キー: $1。この環境では Chrome が割り当てていません。Chrome のショートカットページで設定できます。

settingsChangeInChromeTitle.message: Chrome のキーボードショートカットページを開く
settingsChangeInChromeTitle.description: Tooltip of the Change in Chrome button.

searchClear.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the X button that empties the search box.

searchResultPlace.description: Where a matching tab is, shown beside a saved session's or a snapshot's tab in search results. $1 is the session name, $2 is the window's number (1, 2, ...). Short; it is cut off when too long.

searchRestoreSession.description: Button beside a session in search results that opens the whole session again. Button text, short.

searchResultCount_other.description: Number of search results, beside the results heading and read out by screen readers. $1 is the formatted count.

searchStillLoading.message: セッションをまだ読み込んでいます…
searchStillLoading.description: Shown beside the result count while saved sessions are still being read, so more results may appear.

searchNoMatches.message: 「$1」に一致するものはありません。
searchNoMatches.description: Shown when a search finds nothing. $1 is the text the user typed.

searchShowMore.description: Button under a group of search results that shows more of them. Button text, short.

storageSessionNotFound.message: セッションが見つかりません: $1
storageSessionNotFound.description: Error shown when an action targets a saved session or snapshot that no longer exists (deleted elsewhere). $1 is the session's internal id.

storageUnnamedSession.message: 名前のないセッション
storageUnnamedSession.description: Fallback name for a session in the sidebar when its stored record has no name (e.g. saved by a newer version). Short, like a title.

storageUnknownError.description: Shown in error lines and toasts when a failure carries no message. Short.

errorGeneric.message: 問題が発生しました。詳細はブラウザのコンソールで確認できます。
errorGeneric.description: Shown in error lines and toasts for a failure the extension cannot explain (the technical details go to the browser console).

errorSessionChanged.message: その間にセッションが変更されました。もう一度お試しください。
errorSessionChanged.description: Error when a window, tab or group that was on screen is no longer in the stored session (it was changed in another tab, or by the automatic snapshots).

errorDataUnreadable.message: 保存されたデータを読み込めませんでした。
errorDataUnreadable.description: Error when stored session data is damaged and cannot be read.

errorDataTooNew.message: このデータは新しいバージョンの Tabinet で保存されています。使用するには拡張機能を更新してください。
errorDataTooNew.description: Error when stored data was written by a newer version of the extension. Tabinet is the extension name.

errorRestoreNoWindow.message: Chrome で復元先のウィンドウを開けませんでした。
errorRestoreNoWindow.description: Error when Chrome did not open the new window a restore asked for.

errorTabsBusy.message: Chrome がタブを処理中です。タブをドラッグしている場合は、離してからもう一度お試しください。
errorTabsBusy.description: Error when Chrome refuses to change tabs for a moment, usually because a tab is being dragged.

errorTabGone.message: そのタブまたはウィンドウはもう開いていません。
errorTabGone.description: Error when the tab, window or tab group an action was meant for has been closed meanwhile.

errorWindowBounds.message: 保存されたウィンドウの位置がこの画面に収まりません。
errorWindowBounds.description: Error when a restored window's saved position and size do not fit the current screen.

errorNotAllowed.message: ブラウザで許可されませんでした。
errorNotAllowed.description: Error when the browser refused an action such as copying to the clipboard (for example because the page was not focused).

storageQuotaNotice.message: ストレージがいっぱいです。古いスナップショットやセッションを削除してください。
storageQuotaNotice.description: Red notice shown when saving or importing fails because the extension's local storage is full.

storageShowStorageUse.description: Small button on the 'storage is full' notice; scrolls to the storage meter in Settings. Button, keep short.

storageTotalLine.message: この端末に $1 保存されています
storageTotalLine.description: Storage meter headline in Settings. $1 is a size such as '4.6 MB'.

storageSizeIn.description: One part of the storage meter breakdown, after a coloured dot matching the bar. $1 is a size (e.g. '1.2 MB'), $2 the counted phrase storageSavedSessionCount or storageSnapshotCount (e.g. '12 snapshots').

storageSavedSessionCount_other.message: 保存したセッション $1件
storageSavedSessionCount_other.description: Counted noun phrase used inside storage messages (plural). $1 is the number.

storageSnapshotCount_other.description: Counted noun phrase for automatic snapshots used inside storage messages (plural). $1 is the number.

storageSnapshotHint.message: 自動スナップショットが $1 を使用しています。「保持する件数」を減らすか、スナップショットを削除してください。
storageSnapshotHint.description: Hint under the storage meter when snapshots take most of the space. $1 is a size such as '3.4 MB'. The quoted label is the setting settingsKeepLast; quote its translated text exactly.

storageHeading.description: Heading of the storage meter section in Settings. One or two words.

storageMeasuring.description: Shown in the storage meter while the used space is being measured. Short.

storageDeleteUnprotected.message: スナップショットを削除
storageDeleteUnprotected.description: Small button under the storage meter that deletes every automatic snapshot except the recovered one. Button, keep short.

storageDeleteUnprotectedTooltip.message: 復旧したスナップショット以外の自動スナップショットをすべて削除

storageDeleteSnapshotsNote.message: スナップショットを削除しても、保存したセッションと復旧したスナップショットは残ります。
storageDeleteSnapshotsNote.description: Grey line beside the 'Delete snapshots' button saying what it leaves alone. 'Recovered' is the badge of the snapshot taken before the last browser restart (appNavRecoveredBadge).

storageDeleteAllData.message: セッションデータをすべて削除
storageDeleteAllData.description: Small destructive button under the storage meter that deletes all saved sessions and snapshots. Button, keep short.

storageDeleteAllDataTooltip.message: この端末に保存したすべてのセッションとスナップショットを削除
storageDeleteAllDataTooltip.description: Tooltip of the 'Delete all session data' button.

storageDeletedAllNotice.message: セッションデータをすべて削除しました。設定はそのまま残っています。
storageDeletedAllNotice.description: Toast shown after all session data was deleted.

storageDeletedUnprotectedNotice_other.message: スナップショットを$1件削除しました。
storageDeletedUnprotectedNotice_other.description: Toast after deleting snapshots (plural). $1 is the number deleted.

storageDeleteHistoryTitle.message: スナップショットを削除しますか？
storageDeleteHistoryTitle.description: Title of the confirm dialog for 'Delete snapshots'.

storageDeleteHistoryBody_other.message: $1件のスナップショットをこの端末から削除します。保存したセッションと復旧したスナップショットは残ります。この操作は元に戻せません。
storageDeleteHistoryBody_other.description: Body of the confirm dialog for deleting snapshots (plural). $1 is the number of snapshots.

storageDeleteHistoryConfirm.message: スナップショットを削除
storageDeleteHistoryConfirm.description: Destructive confirm button in the 'Delete snapshots?' dialog. Button, keep short.

storageDeleteAllTitle.message: セッションデータをすべて削除しますか？
storageDeleteAllTitle.description: Title of step one of the two-step 'Delete all session data' confirm dialog.

storageDeleteAllBody.message: $1と$2（$3）をこの端末から削除します。スナップショットと復元の設定は残り、開いているウィンドウやタブには影響しません。
storageDeleteAllBody.description: Body of step one of the 'Delete all session data' dialog. $1 is the counted phrase storageSavedSessionCount (e.g. '3 saved sessions'), $2 the counted phrase storageSnapshotCount (e.g. '12 snapshots'), $3 the total size such as '4.6 MB'.

storageContinue.description: Button on step one of the 'Delete all session data' dialog that goes to the final confirmation. Button, keep short.

storageDeleteAllFinalTitle.message: この操作は元に戻せません
storageDeleteAllFinalTitle.description: Title of step two (final confirmation) of the 'Delete all session data' dialog.

storageDeleteAllFinalBody.message: この端末に保存したすべてのセッションとすべての自動スナップショットが削除されます。事前にバックアップをエクスポートしていない場合、復元することはできません。
storageDeleteAllFinalBody.description: Body of step two (final confirmation) of the 'Delete all session data' dialog.

storageBack.description: Button on step two of the 'Delete all session data' dialog that returns to step one. Button, keep short.

storageDeleteEverything.description: Final destructive button of the 'Delete all session data' dialog. Button, keep short.

restoreWindowLine.description: Small grey line in the restore progress toast saying which window is being filled. $1 is the window number (1-based), $2 the number of windows. Short.

restoreRate_other.description: Restore speed in the progress toast, approximate tabs per second. $1 is the number (may be a decimal such as 0.4). Very short.

restoreLazyHint.message: メモリを節約するため、タブは読み込まずに開きます。各タブはクリックしたときに読み込まれます。
restoreLazyHint.description: Grey hint in the restore progress toast while tabs are opened without loading them.

restoreLazyDone_other.message: $1個のタブは読み込まれていません。クリックすると読み込まれます。
restoreLazyDone_other.description: Grey line under the restore result. $1 is the number of tabs opened without loading.

restoreDestinationHere.message: 「$1」をこのウィンドウに追加します。
restoreDestinationHere.description: Sentence in the confirm dialog before opening a large session into the current window. $1 is the session name.

restoreDestinationNewWindows_other.message: 「$2」を$1個のウィンドウで開きます。
restoreDestinationNewWindows_other.description: Sentence in the confirm dialog before opening a large session in new windows. $1 is the number of windows, $2 the session name.

restoreProgress_other.message: タブを復元しています…（$2/$1）
restoreProgress_other.description: Main line of the restore progress toast. $1 is the total number of tabs, $2 how many are open so far.

restoreCancelling.message: キャンセルしています…
restoreCancelling.description: Label of the Cancel button in the restore progress toast after it was pressed, while the restore stops. Button, keep short.

restoreSummaryRestored_other.message: $1個中$2個のタブを復元しました
restoreSummaryRestored_other.description: First clause of the restore result in the toast; further clauses follow, separated by ' · '. $1 is the number of tabs attempted, $2 how many opened.

restoreSummaryCancelled_other.message: 復元をキャンセルしました: $1個のタブを開きました
restoreSummaryCancelled_other.description: First clause of the result of a cancelled restore; further clauses may follow, separated by ' · '. $1 is the number of tabs opened before Cancel.

restoreSummaryDiscarded_other.message: $1個のタブはクリックすると読み込まれます
restoreSummaryDiscarded_other.description: Clause of the restore result (joined with ' · '), lower-case start in English. $1 is the number of tabs opened without loading.

restoreSummaryKept.message: すでに開いたタブはそのまま残しました
restoreSummaryKept.description: Clause of the result of a cancelled restore (joined with ' · '), lower-case start in English: cancelling does not close the tabs already opened.

restoreSummarySkipped_other.description: Clause of the restore result (joined with ' · '). $1 is the number of tabs not opened because their address cannot be opened by an extension.

restoreSummaryFailed_other.description: Clause of the restore result (joined with ' · '). $1 is the number of tabs Chrome failed to open.

restoreSummaryProblems_other.message: グループ/ウィンドウの問題 $1件
restoreSummaryProblems_other.description: Clause of the restore result (joined with ' · '). $1 is the number of tab groups or window states that could not be recreated.

restoreSkippedItem.description: List item under the restore result. $1 is the address of a tab that was not opened.

restoreFailedItem.description: List item under the restore result. $1 is the address of a tab that failed to open, $2 the reason, a complete sentence already in your language.

restoreFailedItemPlain.description: List item under the restore result when there is no reason that can be shown. $1 is the address of a tab that failed to open.

restoreProblemGroup.message: グループ「$1」を再作成できませんでした（$2）
restoreProblemGroup.description: List item under the restore result. $1 is the name of a tab group that could not be recreated, $2 the reason, a complete sentence already in your language.

restoreProblemGroupPlain.message: グループ「$1」を再作成できませんでした。
restoreProblemGroupPlain.description: List item under the restore result. $1 is the name of a tab group that could not be recreated.

restoreProblemActivate.message: $1 に切り替えられませんでした（$2）
restoreProblemActivate.description: List item under the restore result. $1 is the address of the tab that should have been the window's active tab, $2 the reason, a complete sentence already in your language.

restoreProblemActivatePlain.message: $1 に切り替えられませんでした。
restoreProblemActivatePlain.description: List item under the restore result. $1 is the address of the tab that should have been the window's active tab.

restoreProblemWindowState.message: ウィンドウのサイズを復元できませんでした（$1）
restoreProblemWindowState.description: List item under the restore result when a window could not be maximized, minimized or made full screen as saved. $1 is the reason, a complete sentence already in your language.

restoreProblemWindowStatePlain.message: ウィンドウのサイズを復元できませんでした。
restoreProblemWindowStatePlain.description: List item under the restore result when a window could not be maximized, minimized or made full screen as saved.

restoreDismiss.description: Tooltip and screen-reader label of the x button that closes the restore result toast.

restoreSessionTooNew.message: このセッションは新しいバージョンの Tabinet で保存されたため、表示できません。
restoreSessionTooNew.description: Error shown in place of a session whose stored format is from a newer version of the extension. Tabinet is the extension name.

workerMenuSaveAll.message: すべてのウィンドウをセッションとして保存
workerMenuSaveAll.description: Item in the toolbar icon's right-click menu: saves every open window as one session. Menu item, keep it short (under 40 characters). The Open tabs first-run hint quotes this label too, so it must match the menu.

workerDuplicatesGroupTitle.description: Title of a Chrome tab group that holds duplicate tabs whose address has no host name. $1 is the number of tabs in the group (already formatted). Shown on the small tab group chip, keep it very short (under 20 characters).

workerDuplicatesHostGroupTitle.description: Title of a Chrome tab group that holds duplicate tabs of one address. $1 is the site's host name (such as example.com, never translated), $2 the number of tabs in the group (already formatted). Shown on the small tab group chip, keep it very short.

settingsAccountTitle.description: Heading of the Settings section for signing in to cloud sync. One or two words.

settingsAccountDescription.message: ログインすると、保存したセッションと設定を複数のパソコンでそろえられます。データは自分だけが知るパスフレーズで、このパソコン上で暗号化されます。
settingsAccountDescription.description: Explanation under the Account heading in Settings.

settingsAccountGoogle.description: Label of the Settings row that signs in to cloud sync with a Google account.

settingsAccountSignedOutHint.message: ログインしていません。
settingsAccountSignedOutHint.description: Grey hint under "Google account" in Settings while nobody is signed in.

settingsAccountSignIn.description: Button in Settings that opens Google sign-in for cloud sync. Keep it short.

settingsAccountSignedInAs.message: $1 でログインしています。
settingsAccountSignedInAs.description: Grey hint in Settings while signed in to cloud sync. $1 is the Google email address (never translated).

settingsAccountCreatePassphrase.message: 同期パスフレーズを作成
settingsAccountCreatePassphrase.description: Label of the Settings row where a new cloud sync passphrase is typed twice.

settingsAccountCreatePassphraseHint.message: すべてのデータは、このパソコンを出る前にこのパスフレーズで暗号化されます。誰も代わりに復元できないため、忘れるとクラウド上のコピーは失われます。
settingsAccountCreatePassphraseHint.description: Warning under "Create a sync passphrase" in Settings. It must say clearly that a forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered and the cloud copy is then lost.

settingsAccountPassphrase.description: Label of the field where the sync passphrase is typed.

settingsAccountPassphraseRepeat.message: パスフレーズをもう一度入力
settingsAccountPassphraseRepeat.description: Label of the second field, where a new sync passphrase is typed again.

settingsAccountPassphraseTooShort_other.message: $1 文字以上にしてください。
settingsAccountPassphraseTooShort_other.description: Inline error under a new sync passphrase that is too short. $1 is the minimum number of characters (already formatted).

settingsAccountPassphraseMismatch.message: 2 つのパスフレーズが一致しません。
settingsAccountPassphraseMismatch.description: Inline error when the new sync passphrase and its repetition differ.

settingsAccountCreateButton.description: Button that saves a new sync passphrase. Keep it short.

settingsAccountPassphraseExists.message: このアカウントには、別のパソコンで作成した同期パスフレーズがすでにあります。下に入力してください。
settingsAccountPassphraseExists.description: Notice when the person tried to create a sync passphrase but another computer had already created one.

settingsAccountUnlock.message: 同期パスフレーズを入力
settingsAccountUnlock.description: Label of the Settings row where the existing sync passphrase is typed on a new computer.

settingsAccountUnlockHint.message: このアカウントには同期パスフレーズがすでにあります。このパソコンで同期を使うには入力してください。
settingsAccountUnlockHint.description: Grey hint under "Enter your sync passphrase" in Settings.

settingsAccountUnlockButton.description: Button that checks the typed sync passphrase. One word.

settingsAccountWrongPassphrase.message: パスフレーズが正しくありません。もう一度お試しください。
settingsAccountWrongPassphrase.description: Inline error when the typed sync passphrase does not match the account.

settingsAccountReady.message: 同期パスフレーズをこのパソコンに保存しました。
settingsAccountReady.description: Toast after a sync passphrase was created or entered correctly.

settingsAccountReadyHint.message: 同期は次のアップデートで利用できるようになります。
settingsAccountReadyHint.description: Grey hint in Settings once signed in and the passphrase is set: syncing itself is not available yet.

settingsAccountSignOut.description: Button in Settings that signs out of cloud sync on this computer. Keep it short.

settingsAccountSignedOut.message: ログアウトしました。このパソコンのセッションはそのまま残っています。
settingsAccountSignedOut.description: Toast after signing out of cloud sync.

settingsAccountDelete.message: クラウドのデータを削除
settingsAccountDelete.description: Button in Settings, and the confirming button of its dialog, that deletes the cloud sync account and everything stored for it on the server. Keep it short.

settingsAccountDeleteTitle.message: クラウドのデータを削除しますか?
settingsAccountDeleteTitle.description: Title of the dialog that asks before deleting the cloud sync account.

settingsAccountDeleteBody.message: アカウントと、同期サーバーに保存されたすべてのデータを削除します。元に戻せません。このパソコンのセッションは残ります。
settingsAccountDeleteBody.description: Body of the dialog that asks before deleting the cloud sync account.

settingsAccountDeleted.message: クラウドのデータを削除しました。
settingsAccountDeleted.description: Toast after the cloud sync account and its data were deleted.

errorCloudUnreachable.message: 同期サーバーに接続できません。接続を確認して、もう一度お試しください。
errorCloudUnreachable.description: Error when the sync server could not be reached (no network, server down).

errorCloudServer.message: 同期サーバーで問題が発生しました。しばらくしてからお試しください。
errorCloudServer.description: Error when the sync server answered with a server error (5xx).

errorCloudRejected.message: 同期サーバーがリクエストを拒否しました。
errorCloudRejected.description: Error when the sync server refused a request for a reason the extension cannot explain.

errorCloudSignedOut.message: ログアウトされました。もう一度ログインしてください。
errorCloudSignedOut.description: Error when the sync server no longer accepts the sign-in (expired or revoked), so the account was signed out on this computer.

errorCloudSignInFailed.message: Google でのログインに失敗しました。もう一度お試しください。
errorCloudSignInFailed.description: Error when Google sign-in for cloud sync failed.

errorCloudDecrypt.message: 同期されたデータの一部を復号できませんでした。
errorCloudDecrypt.description: Error when data from the sync server does not decrypt with this computer's sync key.

errorCloudBadResponse.message: 同期サーバーから、このバージョンでは読めない応答が届きました。
errorCloudBadResponse.description: Error when the sync server's answer has an unexpected shape.

commonTryAgain.description: Button that repeats something that failed, such as reading the cloud sync account. Keep it short.
